title: CS2-Box Box Definition
description: Schema for a CS2-Box crate / terminal definition (config/csbox/<id>.json). The file name (minus .json) becomes the box id. Terminal prices are NOT part of box files anymore — they live in the central price table config/csbox/_prices.json (see prices.schema.json); a leftover 'price' field is rejected by the runtime validator. Runtime validation in-game is authoritative; this schema is an authoring aid for IDE autocomplete / offline checks.

name.description: Display name shown on the box item and GUI. May start with a '#RRGGBB ' color prefix (e.g. "#FF5555 神化宝石箱").

type.description: csbox = regular crate (default), terminal = terminal machine. Terminals must NOT declare a key field.

key.description: Key item id required to open. Use minecraft:air for a keyless box. Terminals forbid this field.

random.description: Five grade weights ordered grade1(common)..grade5(rare). Non-positive uses defaults; >10000 clamps.

entity.description: Entity ids that drop this box, or alternating id/rate pairs.

enabled.description: v2.1.0: false skips this box entirely (no error).

requires.description: v2.1.0: list of mod ids that must be loaded; the box is skipped with an error when any is missing.

oneOf.description: Item-model id (26.x renders directly; other versions warn)
CustomModelData value (pair with a resource pack)

discount.description: v2.1.0: terminal price discount (0..1 off), e.g. 0.2 = 20% off.

restock_minutes.description: v2.1.0: minutes between stock refills; 0 = never auto-restock.

max_per_player.description: v2.1.0: per-player open cap; -1 = unlimited (in-memory, resets on restart).

permission.description: v2.1.0: permission node checked against the PERMISSION_GATE hook (default allow-all).

grade.description: Items in this grade tier (grade1 lowest rarity .. grade5 highest).

item.description: One item pool entry. Exactly one source: id, '#tag' or loot_table. Terminal prices come from the central _prices.json table, never from this object.

tag.description: Item tag reference starting with '#', e.g. #minecraft:swords. Expanded at load time.

loot_table.description: Loot table reference, e.g. minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon. Rolled at open time.

count.description: Item count, or [min,max] rolled at open time (v2.1.0).

weight.description: v2.1.0: intra-grade weight; 0 disables the entry.

enchant.description: v2.1.0: random-enchant shortcut (true = any enchant, or {id, level}).

price.description: REMOVED — do not use. Terminal prices are centrally managed in config/csbox/_prices.json (see prices.schema.json). A leftover price here is reported by the in-game validator; this item then falls back to the grade default price until migrated.

tag_nbt.description: Legacy NBT tag string (1.20.1 / old configs).
